items.name: NIC: Disable Adapter Power Management (all physical adapters)
items.description: Uses NetAdapter cmdlets to disable adapter-level power management on physical NICs.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ Disable-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name $n.Name -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-NetAdapterPowerManagement -Name * | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: NIC: Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) where present
items.description: Enumerates advanced properties and disables EEE only on adapters that expose the property.

steps.command: $nics=Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($n in $nics){ $props=Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -AllProperties -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $eee=$props | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match "Energy Efficient Ethernet|EEE" -or $_.RegistryKeyword -match "EEE" }; foreach($p in $eee){ Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty -Name $n.Name -RegistryKeyword $p.RegistryKeyword -RegistryValue 0 -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output "EEE property pass complete."
